description.value:
Requirements You are standing in a [TERRAIN] effect you created.

Duration constant

Your spells gain a +1 status bonus to their DCs against creatures that are also within that same [TERRAIN] effect. Creatures outside it, and creatures inside a different [TERRAIN] effect of yours than the one you are standing in, are unaffected.

cinderfall.incomplete: A real, clean `FlatModifier`-shaped bonus (P1) blocked purely by `TERRAIN-NULL`: no roll option exists for "target and I are in the same GM-tracked terrain zone." Unlike Hardy Growth/Living Fortification, this bonus targets the *caster's own check*, not a wall's stated stats, so it doesn't fall under the "never modeled" Wall-of-Stone precedent — it's a genuine gap, not a convention.
